steps.title: Somebody says: “Modern art is a waste of money.” Which reply is politer?
options: I take your point, but some of it does change how people see things.
steps.answer: I take your point, but some of it does change how people see things.

steps.title: Somebody says: “Modern art is a waste of money.” Which reply is politer?
options: I’m not sure about that — have you seen the underwater park?
You clearly know nothing about art.
steps.answer: I’m not sure about that — have you seen the underwater park?

steps.title: Somebody says: “Modern art is a waste of money.” Which reply is politer?
options: True, a lot of it is expensive — but not all of it.
steps.answer: True, a lot of it is expensive — but not all of it.

steps.title: Somebody says: “Modern art is a waste of money.” Which reply is politer?
options: That’s a good point, although I’d say it depends on the artist.
Everybody says that and everybody is wrong.
steps.answer: That’s a good point, although I’d say it depends on the artist.

steps.title: Now answer three hard questions about it, out loud.
Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ give an opinion and mark it as one — In my opinion… / I’d say that…
✓ agree, and say why it is a good point
✓ disagree without sounding hard — I take your point, but… / I’m afraid I disagree
✓ say you have no strong view, and stop there
✓ structure a short talk — Firstly · Secondly · In addition · To sum up
✓ open and close in front of an audience — Thanks for coming … Any questions?
